issue: The 0.005 refinement selected minima from a mixed coarse/refined table. Isolated coarse points with no 0.02 neighbors were incorrectly admitted as minima.
disposition: Exploratory fine-step runs were stopped and excluded from aggregate search results, acceptance, and confirmation.
corrective_rule: Seed each refinement only from successful stationary results on the immediately preceding completed grid; persist every refinement batch.
